nodes.label: Karl Playground
nodes.rationale: Zero-setup browser environment served by `karl playground` on localhost:8081/bench so newcomers can run Karl without installing a toolchain.

nodes.label: Client-Side WASM Interpreter
nodes.rationale: Compiling the interpreter to assets/playground/karl.wasm keeps execution entirely on the user's machine: no backend server to run, and no user code is ever sent over the network (security + zero hosting cost).

nodes.label: syscall/js Go-to-Browser Bridge
nodes.rationale: Bridges the Go WASM runtime to JavaScript; interpreter stdout is captured by a custom JS polyfill and rendered in the output pane.

nodes.label: WASM Rebuild Step (GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm)
nodes.rationale: Because the playground ships a prebuilt binary, core language changes are invisible until karl.wasm is rebuilt from ./wasm and the server restarted.
